subject: Planning: NovusHealth Executive Workshop — hybrid schedule & travel sync
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@novushealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T13:02:00-04:00
Subject: Exec workshop — high-level dates and hybrid ask

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're planning a 1.5-day executive workshop to align on rollout and integration priorities and would like Redwood to lead the technical breakout and an executive roadmap session. Tentative windows: Oct 18–20 (Boston) — preference for Oct 19 onsite with Oct 18/20 as remote prep/wrap.

We have leadership in US (ET), EU (CET) and APAC (SGT) participating; we need a hybrid plan that keeps the Boston onsite session tightly timed for executives and a virtual bridge for APAC colleagues.

Can you share:
- Availability windows for Redwood execs/eng leads for Oct 18–20
- Suggested agenda (high level) for a 1.5-day format
- Any on-site logistics you need from us (AV specs, headcount, dietary)

Also please confirm if Redwood can provide an AV tech onsite and a secure virtual bridge (we need an encrypted meeting room).

Best,
Alice
Alice Monroe
VP, Strategic Partnerships — NovusHealth

Attachments: none
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T15:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — high-level dates and hybrid ask

Hi Alice — great to hear from you, thanks for the clear windows. We're available on Oct 18–20; we recommend making Oct 19 the primary onsite day and running two focused virtual blocks to include APAC. Proposed high-level cadence: 

Day -1 (Oct 18) — remote prep: 13:00–16:00 ET (intro + alignment, pre-reads)
Day 0 (Oct 19) — onsite (Boston) + hybrid bridge: 09:00–12:30 ET (exec session + roadmap) 
  - 12:30–13:30 ET (lunch onsite)
  - 13:30–16:30 ET (technical breakouts; live-streamed)
Evening (Oct 19) — 19:00–20:00 SGT (APAC sync/recorded recap)
Day +1 (Oct 20) — remote follow-up: 10:00–11:30 ET (action item review)

I'll attach an initial agenda (agenda_v1.pdf) and a short venue map. Quick asks from our side:
- Final headcount for onsite and remote viewers by 2026-09-21
- AV contact and build specs (we can adapt if you provide vendor info)
- Dietary list for onsite exec lunch by 2026-09-28

We can provide an AVR tech onsite (Marissa will coordinate travel), and we use a dedicated, encrypted Zoom room for customer exec sessions (link included below). I will loop in Marissa and Connor to confirm the Redwood roster and travel windows.

Thanks — we'll hold tentative calendar slots internally and send formal invites once dates are firm.

Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), venue_map.png (image)
Related links: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — internal travel & ops (Marissa coordinating AV)

Dylan / Connor — I can own AV and on-site logistics. Planning notes for Redwood: 
- Roster: Dylan (executive), Marissa (AV lead), Connor (solutions engineer), Priyom (product PM, remote)
- Travel windows: fly into BOS evening Oct 18, depart evening Oct 19 (unless customer requests additional onsite day)
- Hotel: propose Seaport area (walking distance to customer HQ) — will share options and rates by EOD 2026-09-17
- AV: I'll bring a streaming encoder, backup hotspot, and a spare mic pack. I'll need venue AV rack access and IP for the bridge.

Action items for internal team:
- Connor: confirm demo environment needs (GPU access, local model checkpoints) by 2026-09-20
- Priyom: draft a 30-minute roadmap deck slice and a 3-slide follow-up summary by 2026-09-18

I'll also create calendar holds for the team (tentative) and tag them "Novus — onsite (tentative)". Dylan, do you want me to send official calendar invites to Novus or wait until they confirm headcount/date?

Marissa
Senior Events & Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@novushealth.com>

Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-09-16T11:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — high-level dates and hybrid ask

Dylan / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and agenda. We like Oct 19 as the onsite day. Confirmed details below: 

Confirmed onsite date: Oct 19 (Boston HQ)
Onsite headcount: 11 execs + 6 product/eng observers
Remote participants: EU (CET) — 8, APAC (SGT) — 3 (will join the evening bridge)
Dietary: 3 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free, 1 halal
Venue AV: we can provide a Crestron-managed AV rack and will give access to your AV lead on arrival.

Procurement note: we've raised a PO and sent a DocuSign for the SOW (link below). Please confirm when you receive the PO and whether Redwood needs a vendor form (I can route to our procurement contact).

Attendee list (for badges):
- Alice Monroe (VP, Strategic Partnerships)
- Tom Lee (CIO)
- Morgan Ellis (Head of PM)
- Jared Kim (VP Eng)
- ... (full list attached)

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Alice

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-21T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — hybrid schedule & travel sync (confirmed)

Alice / team — all set on our side. Quick confirmation and next steps: 

1) Calendar invites: Marissa is sending formal calendar invites for the Redwood roster and the joint Novus calendar invite; expect those by EOD PDT. Please share the Novus meeting room booking; we'll send the encrypted Zoom bridge link in the calendar invite.
2) PO / procurement: procurement@redwood.com has the DocuSign link; we'll confirm receipt and routing internally.
3) AV access: Marissa will request Crestron rack access on arrival and will have a short check at 08:00 ET on Oct 19.
4) Deliverables: Connor will bring the demo image and a small local model checkpoint (no external internet required for the demo). Priyom will share the 3-slide follow-up by Oct 20 close.

Attachments we've uploaded to our shared drive for the team: agenda_v1.pdf, venue_map.png, dietary_list.csv. I'll also add a shared folder link in the invite.

If anything changes on Novus' end (headcount or timing), please flag by 2026-09-28 so we can adjust travel.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
